title: The global women's library
subtitle: Because it's a big wide world, and the page count is enormous

posts.title: Bhutan: Tales in Colour, by Kunzang Choden
posts.description: Thirteen short stories exploring the life of women in rural Bhutan, focusing on the strengths of individual women and community ties.

posts.title: Chile: Piñen, by Daniela Catrileo
posts.description: Four stories about the lives of Indigenous Mapuche youth in Chile, using the Mapudungun word 'piñen' - sometimes used as a racist slur against Mapuche people in Chile - to subvert notions of shame and trauma in a settler-colonialist state.

posts.title: Republic of Naoero: Four stories from Stories from Nauru, ed. Larry Roberts
posts.description: Four short stories written during a creative writing workshop about the folklore and history of Naoero, using the island's folklore as the basis to explore themes of marginalisation and cultural decline amongst Indigenous Pacific communities.
